subject: science
concept: Understanding levels of biological organization: cells, tissues, organs, organ systems, organisms
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges organization-level cards (cell, tissue, organ, system, organism) in correct nested order
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a biological example to its correct level of organization
exercise.abstract: Student explains how the levels of biological organization build on each other

misconception_flags: places levels of organization out of correct nested order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
